/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'listarproductos_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Producto List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductoCategoriaNombre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductoCategoriaNombre
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductoBaseProductoClave.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductoBaseProductoClave
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductoClave_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductoClave_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductoClave.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductoClave
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductoNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductoNombre_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductoNombre.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductoNombre
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductoDescripcion_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductoDescripcion_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductoDescripcion.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductoDescripcion
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoPrecioUnitario.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFProductoPrecioUnitario
		&TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Precio Unitario", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFProductoPrecioUnitario_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoInventarioActual.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductoInventarioActual_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFProductoInventarioActual
		&TFProductoInventarioActual_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Inventario Actual", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFProductoInventarioActual_To
	EndIf
	&TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
	If not &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels.Count = 0
		&i = 1
		For &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sel in &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels
			If &i = 1
				&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelDscs = ''
			Else
				&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelDscs += ', '
			EndIf
			&FilterTFProductoTipoMaterial_SelValueDescription = &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sel.EnumerationDescription()

			&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelDscs += &FilterTFProductoTipoMaterial_SelValueDescription
			&i += 1
		EndFor
		print printBlockTFProductoTipoMaterial_Sel
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductoActivo_Sel.IsEmpty()
		Do Case
			Case &TFProductoActivo_Sel = 1
				&FilterTFProductoActivo_SelValueDescription = "WWP_TSChecked" 
			Case &TFProductoActivo_Sel = 2
				&FilterTFProductoActivo_SelValueDescription = "WWP_TSUnChecked" 
		EndCase

		print printBlockTFProductoActivo_Sel
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductoClaveExterna.IsEmpty() AND &TFProductoClaveExterna_To.IsEmpty())
		print printBlockTFProductoClaveExterna
		&TFProductoClaveExterna_To_Description = format('%1 (%2)', "Clave Externa", "WWP_TSTo")
		print printBlockTFProductoClaveExterna_To
	EndIf
	If not &TFProductNumber_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFProductNumber_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFProductNumber.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFProductNumber
		EndIf
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	print printBlockBeforeGrid
	print printBlockLines_titles

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each DB.Producto
		order ProductoNombre  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoCategoriaNombre  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoCategoriaNombre)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoBaseProductoClave  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoBaseProductoClave)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoClave  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoClave)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoDescripcion  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoDescripcion)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoPrecioUnitario  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoPrecioUnitario)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoInventarioActual  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoInventarioActual)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoTipoMaterial  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoTipoMaterial)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoActivo  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoActivo)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductoClaveExterna  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductoClaveExterna)  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductNumber  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductNumber)  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using listarProductosDS(&FilterFullText, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre, &TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave, &TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoClave
					, &TFProductoClave_Sel, &TFProductoNombre, &TFProductoNombre_Sel, &TFProductoDescripcion, &TFProductoDescripcion_Sel, &TFProductoPrecioUnitario
					, &TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To, &TFProductoInventarioActual, &TFProductoInventarioActual_To, &TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels, &TFProductoActivo_Sel, &TFProductoClaveExterna
					, &TFProductoClaveExterna_To, &TFProductNumber, &TFProductNumber_Sel)
		&ProductoTipoMaterialDescription = ProductoTipoMaterial.EnumerationDescription()

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarProductosGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarProductosGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarProductosGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCATEGORIANOMBRE"
				&TFProductoCategoriaNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCATEGORIANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFProductoCategoriaNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOBASEPRODUCTOCLAVE"
				&TFProductoBaseProductoClave.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOBASEPRODUCTOCLAVE_SEL"
				&TFProductoBaseProductoClave_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCLAVE"
				&TFProductoClave.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCLAVE_SEL"
				&TFProductoClave_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTONOMBRE"
				&TFProductoNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTONOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFProductoNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTODESCRIPCION"
				&TFProductoDescripcion.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTODESCRIPCION_SEL"
				&TFProductoDescripcion_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOPRECIOUNITARIO"
				&TFProductoPrecioUnitario.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFProductoPrecioUnitario_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOINVENTARIOACTUAL"
				&TFProductoInventarioActual.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFProductoInventarioActual_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOTIPOMATERIAL_SEL"
				&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFProductoTipoMaterial_Sels.FromJson(&TFProductoTipoMaterial_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOACTIVO_SEL"
				&TFProductoActivo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTOCLAVEEXTERNA"
				&TFProductoClaveExterna.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFProductoClaveExterna_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTNUMBER"
				&TFProductNumber.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTNUMBER_SEL"
				&TFProductNumber_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */



	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub
